welcome_message: Create a bounded Skyulf pandas/Polars Bundle. dev is ready for your CLI profile; edit test, syst and prod target settings before using them.

row_key.description: Existing source column identifying one prediction row (also copied to output)

retraining_mode.description: Train manually, or add a paused monthly schedule to the same train job

model_change_mode.description: Keep old predictions and append new rows, or rebuild all rows into a new model-version generation

score_model_selection.description: Score with one pinned version or resolve the controlled champion on each run

promotion_policy.description: Require operator approval or promote automatically after quality gates pass

score_handoff.description: Optionally run the existing score job after champion initialization, promotion or rollback; score keeps its selected model policy

metric.description: Heldout comparison metric; auto selects RMSE for regression or accuracy for classification

min_improvement.description: Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

quality_threshold.description: Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

retraining_cron_expression.description: Editable Quartz cron for the paused training job; use one run per month

retraining_timezone_id.description: IANA timezone used by the paused training schedule; training windows remain UTC months

compute_mode.description: Job compute mode for this project

spark_version.description: Approved Databricks ML Runtime for the job cluster

cost_tag_key.description: Approved cluster cost tag key, for example CostCenter or PayingRegNo

cost_tag_value.description: Approved cluster cost tag value; for PayingRegNo, enter your paying registration number

risk_category.description: Optional business risk label (e.g. Low, Medium, High); leave blank when unused. This label does not change promotion gates.

task.description: Model task; selects a starting estimator and automatic heldout metric

source_table_name.description: Existing source table name within the input schema; blank uses <project_name>_source

score_source_table_name.description: Existing scoring table name within the input schema; blank reuses the training source

row_keys_json.description: Optional JSON array of existing jointly unique source keys; overrides row_key

input_columns_json.description: JSON array of existing model feature columns; exclude keys and target

event_column.description: Existing event timestamp column for the temporal training split

label_time_column.description: Existing timestamp column recording when each training label became available

training_version.description: Concrete nonnegative Delta source version for manual training; null requires configuration before running

start.description: Manual training start as a timezone-aware ISO timestamp; blank requires configuration before running

holdout_start.description: Manual heldout split start as a timezone-aware ISO timestamp

cutoff.description: Manual label-availability cutoff as a timezone-aware ISO timestamp

max_rows.description: Positive row limit for each bounded local data transfer

max_bytes.description: Positive byte limit for each bounded local data transfer
